verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe near-real-time database replication into BigQuery, scheduled one-time or batch data transfers, and a Pub/Sub subscription for streaming ingestion, so part of the connector story is documented. However, nothing in the pack shows SaaS-app connectors or a partner ETL/ELT connector catalog. A community user also reported that getting Cloud SQL data in was hard and needed a third-party tool, which tempers confidence on database coverage. Missing for 10: documented SaaS application connectors, a partner ETL/ELT tool integration catalog, step-by-step connector setup documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of connector breadth.
